title: Implement Collision Detection and Spatial Partitioning
description: Develop a collision detection system (AABB/Circle-based) handling interactions between projectiles, asteroids, and the player spacecraft. Include unit tests for overlap detection and collision callbacks.
acceptanceCriteria: Collision detection accurately identifies intersections between projectiles and asteroids
Player-asteroid collisions trigger loss of life or game over state
reviewFeedback: The collision detection and spatial partitioning module is clean, adheres to modular architecture principles, includes comprehensive unit tests covering all required interaction types, and properly handles edge cases such as inactive entities and broad-phase grid binning.
